policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="budgetUsage" value="@{
      try {
        var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        var usage = body["usage"] as JObject;
        if (usage == null || usage["prompt_tokens"] == null || usage["completion_tokens"] == null) { return ""; }
        return new JObject(new JProperty("usage", new JObject(
          new JProperty("promptTokens", (long)usage["prompt_tokens"]),
          new JProperty("completionTokens", (long)usage["completion_tokens"]),
          new JProperty("cachedInputTokens", (long?)usage["prompt_tokens_details"]?["cached_tokens"] ?? 0)))).ToString();
      } catch { return ""; }
    }" />
    
      
        
          
            @("{{ContainerAppUrl}}/api/budgets/" + (string)context.Variables["budgetTenant"] + "/reservations/" + context.RequestId.ToString() + "/settle")
            POST
            @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["budgetEngineToken"])
            application/json
            @((string)context.Variables["budgetUsage"])
          
        
      
    
    @(context.RequestId.ToString())
    @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("budgetSettlement") && context.Variables["budgetSettlement"] != null && ((IResponse)context.Variables["budgetSettlement"]).StatusCode == 200 ? "settled" : "pending-reconciliation")
    
    
      {{ContainerAppUrl}}/api/log
      POST
      @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["budgetEngineToken"])
      application/json
      @{
        JObject response = null;
        try { response = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true); } catch { }
        var precheck = ((IResponse)context.Variables["budgetPrecheck"]).Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        return new JObject(
          new JProperty("tenantId", (string)context.Variables["budgetTenant"]),
          new JProperty("clientAppId", (string)context.Variables["budgetClient"]),
          new JProperty("deploymentId", (string)context.Variables["budgetActualDeployment"]),
          new JProperty("responseBody", response),
          new JProperty("planId", precheck["planId"]),
          new JProperty("accessProfileId", precheck["accessProfileId"]),
          new JProperty("apiId", context.Api.Id),
          new JProperty("correlationId", context.RequestId.ToString())).ToString();
      }
